note.en: Experimental exact-FIX6a build with bounded QA. Full-story testing is pending; EVIV editing and Kris are not included.
note.es: Build experimental FIX6a exacto con QA acotado. Falta probar la historia completa; no incluye editor EVIV ni Kris.

note.en: Latest cumulative candidate: Kris and updated credits, with earlier features and an experimental stat editor included by reviewed lineage. Editor cases were tested on earlier builds; no new editor QA was performed on this candidate. Known Bag crop/contrast limits remain; full adventure and hardware are not certified. Wiki data and cheat checks are based on Alpha 2 and have not been verified against this candidate. Cross-build save compatibility has not been established. Uses your clean HeartGold USA dump.
note.es: Candidata acumulativa más reciente: Kris y créditos actualizados, con funciones anteriores y un editor de estadísticas experimental incluidos por linaje revisado. Los casos del editor se probaron en versiones anteriores; no se realizaron nuevas pruebas del editor en esta candidata. Se mantienen los límites de recorte/contraste de la Bolsa; no se certifican aventura completa ni hardware. Los datos de la wiki y las comprobaciones de trucos corresponden a Alfa 2 y no se han verificado contra esta candidata. No se ha establecido la compatibilidad de partidas entre versiones. Usa tu dump limpio de HeartGold USA.
